indicator: Children age 6-14 enrolled in government schools
interpretation: Access story: most rural Tamil Nadu children remain inside the schooling system, with a large government-school footprint.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 1

interpretation: Success signal: exclusion from school is very low among children aged 6-14 in rural Tamil Nadu.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 1

indicator: Std III children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Warning signal: foundational reading remains weak despite broad access.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 4 and Table 5

indicator: Std V children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Warning signal: by Std V, only about one-third can read Std II level text.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 4 and Table 6

indicator: Std VIII children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Mixed signal: recovery is visible at higher grades, but universal basic reading is still not achieved.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 4 and Table 6

indicator: Std III government-school children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Government-school reading is still low at the foundational stage.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 5

indicator: Std III private-school children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Private-school advantage is not automatic at Std III reading in the ASER Tamil Nadu rural sample.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 5

indicator: Std V government-school children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Government-school Std V reading recovered from 2022 but remains below 2014-2018 levels.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 6

indicator: Std V private-school children who can read Std II level text
interpretation: Private-school Std V reading also remains below pre-pandemic levels.
source_note: ASER 2024 Final Report, Tamil Nadu Rural state profile, Table 6
